note: FNS 1036.2 simply directs to Section 512 data matching requirements for verifying negative allegations of other government benefits (Black Lung, Railroad Retirement, etc.). Section 512 requires IEVS checks for all adult household members to confirm negative allegations. The OLG comprehensively covers this through its External Databases procedures and Matches/PI Checklist system. The External Databases page explicitly requires workers to check BENDEX/SDX (SVES) to 'verify there is no SSI or RSDI income,' Work Number to 'confirm that there are no wages being received,' and EMT to 'confirm that there is no UC being received' when a client reports no income — this is the functional equivalent of IEVS verification of negative allegations. The PI Checklist includes PARIS Veterans (VA benefits), DOR matches, DUA, and numerous other government data sources. While the OLG does not use the FNS term 'negative allegation,' the data matching procedures serve the identical verification purpose required by Section 512.
